drafts.lead: Heather, El Toro Tours — 'Who is we? You have no signature and the automiqo.co website doesn't exist.'
drafts.body:
Heather,

That is a completely fair thing to pull me up on, and you are right on both counts.

The company is Koldify. koldify.io, and https://koldify.io/#results is the part worth reading. I am Jennifer Wilson and I work there.

On the domain: automiqo.co is a sending domain we use for outreach rather than a website, which is standard practice for this kind of campaign but looks exactly as dubious as you found it when you go and check. You were right to check. Anyone doing outbound properly should expect that and have an answer, so here is mine rather than a shrug.

What we would actually do for El Toro Tours: run outbound to corporate event planners, wedding coordinators, winery and tasting-room managers and group trip organisers, in your name, so the people planning those outings come to you. Flat monthly retainer, nothing per lead.

If you would rather see the site and think about it before giving up any time, that is completely reasonable. If you do want to talk:

• Thursday, August 13 at 2:00 PM EDT
• Monday, August 17 at 2:00 PM EDT
• Tuesday, August 18 at 2:00 PM EDT

Jennifer Wilson
Koldify

drafts.lead: Olga Bodnar, President BSL Express — wants details on how it works before the call
drafts.body:
Olga,

Of course. Here is the whole of it.

We build a list of the shippers you want: manufacturers and construction suppliers moving flatbed freight in the lanes BSL actually runs. We register separate sending domains and mailboxes so bslexpresstrucking.com is never put at risk, warm them for a few weeks, then send in your name. Anyone interested replies directly to you and the conversation is yours from the first message.

We are not handing you a list and we are not introducing you to people we represent. We start conversations, you close them.

Commercials: flat monthly retainer. Nothing per lead and nothing on the freight you win.

Timing: two to three weeks of setup and warming before volume sending, first replies usually in week three or four.

Still open:

• Thursday, August 13 at 9:30 AM EDT (8:30 AM your time)
• Monday, August 17 at 2:00 PM EDT (1:00 PM your time)
• Tuesday, August 18 at 2:00 PM EDT (1:00 PM your time)

Fiona

drafts.lead: Corey Matthews, Best Trash — asked whether this is broker-based work in Houston or Dallas
drafts.body:
Corey,

No brokers. That is the point of it.

We would go direct to the people who actually award the contract: HOA boards and their management companies, municipal contacts, commercial property managers. They reply to you, you quote them, and there is nobody in the middle taking a slice of the route.

Houston and Dallas both work. Which one we start with is worth deciding deliberately rather than doing both thinly, and that depends on where you have capacity to absorb new routes.

Flat monthly retainer, nothing per lead and nothing per contract you win.

If that is the right shape:

• Thursday, August 13 at 2:00 PM EDT (1:00 PM your time)
• Monday, August 17 at 1:30 PM EDT (12:30 PM your time)
• Tuesday, August 18 at 1:30 PM EDT (12:30 PM your time)

Lisa
